groups.title: agent skills shipped with the repo

rules.rule: production code never calls JSON.parse directly; it uses parseJSON or safeParseJSON from @ai-sdk/provider-utils

every getFromApi call sets validateUrl explicitly: true for URLs from a provider response body, false only for URLs built from a configured baseURL; pass credentialedOrigin when the first hop may carry the API key
rules.why: omitting it skips validation; the ai-sdk/require-validate-url oxlint rule fails pnpm check (AGENTS.md:239-249, contributing/secure-url-handling.md)

rules.rule: every PR that changes production code under packages/ carries a patch changeset
a public API change updates the documentation in content/docs in the same PR
after a change, the whole workspace type-checks, examples included
Zod 3 only through zod/v3 for compatibility code, Zod 4 through zod/v4 with z4.core.$ZodType for type references
